public_sources_and_research_lanes.core_text: By Baptism God has made you a member of the holy Christian church.
public_sources_and_research_lanes.safe_argument: The certificate is the direct evidence that a religious institution permanently recorded God-language and church-belonging language about Jeremiah.

public_sources_and_research_lanes.core_text: Jeremiah O'Neal will always, now and forever, have one foot in the God mentioned in the 1983 certificate's church, and that foot would remain there forever.
public_sources_and_research_lanes.safe_argument: This is an interpretation of the certificate text, not a claim that archaeology proves Lutheran doctrine.
